_HOW_TO: PUT any website link in a slot's 'url'. Three kinds work:
1. Bare domain:  https://pngtree.com  -> page fetched directly AND boosted via Bing 'your-query site:pngtree.com'
2. Category page: https://www.cleanpng.com/free/christmas.html -> fetched AS-IS (do not add ?s= yourself).
3. Template:     https://mysite.com/search?q={query} -> {query} is replaced by the search word.
'type': 'image' or 'gif'. 'enabled': false switches a slot off without deleting it.
v2.5 HOT-RELOAD: edit this file and the NEXT search already uses it — NO restart needed.
v2.5 YOUR LINKS ARE TRIED FIRST and their results LEAD the list (the bot downloads images[0]).
v2.5 no-file option: set MYLINKS env var on this service or on the bot (comma-separated URLs).
CHECK /my-links in a browser — per-slot diagnostics: lastResult {count, error, ts}.
v2.5 hotlink fix: pngtree/cloudfront downloads now send Referer automatically; the bot also retries the next result.
A dead slot never breaks a search — it is skipped, logged, and shown in the diagnostics.
